import json, subprocess, sys, time

import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/liuxuedeng/Django-Agent')
evidence = root / 'docs/refactor-evidence'
destination = evidence / '20261012-ipc-receipt-freeze.json'
owned = {
    'packages/core/src/adapters/ipc.ts': '0538e3b004652fd594899bd65ceac248614fb0cea82e12892bec180565b71916',
    'packages/core/test/ipc-receipt-recovery.test.ts': '25834a50d811fda9bd93055e271c4ededc84358e23a9ba02efe4a168c30605d9',
    'docs/desktop-refactor/IPC-RECEIPT-RECOVERY.md': '6ba3a3d6b54034e4a4b7bd606c15358994f6bd81a2044a3dc76d331a92891d9c',
}
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

for name, expected in owned.items():
    assert sha(root/name) == expected, name
checks = []
for name in owned:
    command = ['git', 'diff', '--no-index', '--check', '/dev/null', name]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode in (0, 1) and not result.stdout and not result.stderr, (name, result)
    checks.append({'path': name, 'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'no_whitespace_diagnostics': True})
tracked = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check', '--', *owned], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert tracked.returncode == 0 and not tracked.stdout and not tracked.stderr
commands = []
for prefix in ['20261012-ipc-receipt-red', '20261012-ipc-receipt-red-corrected', '20261012-ipc-receipt-crash-red',
               '20261012-ipc-receipt-first-green', '20261012-ipc-receipt-green',
               '20261012-ipc-receipt-final-green', '20261012-ipc-receipt-related', '20261012-ipc-receipt-typecheck']:
    metadata, log = evidence/(prefix+'.json'), evidence/(prefix+'.tap')
    record = json.loads(metadata.read_text())
    record.update({'metadata_path': str(metadata.relative_to(root)), 'metadata_sha256': sha(metadata),
                   'log_path': str(log.relative_to(root)), 'log_sha256': sha(log)})
    for count in ['tests', 'pass', 'fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped']:
        match = re.search(r'^# '+count+r' (\d+)$', log.read_text(), re.MULTILINE)
        if match:
            record[count] = int(match.group(1))
    commands.append(record)
assert commands[-3]['pass'] == 20 and commands[-3]['fail'] == 0 and commands[-3]['exit_code'] == 0
assert commands[-2]['pass'] == 19 and commands[-2]['fail'] == 0 and commands[-2]['exit_code'] == 0
assert commands[-1]['exit_code'] == 0

destination.write_text('{}\n')
document = root/'docs/desktop-refactor/IPC-RECEIPT-RECOVERY.md'
links = []
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', document.read_text()):
    if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):
        continue
    path = (document.parent/target.split('#', 1)[0]).resolve()
    assert path.is_file(), str(path)
    links.append({'target': target, 'resolved': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'exists': True})
scripts = [Path('/tmp/marlin-ipc-receipt-command.py'), Path(__file__)]
cleanup = [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(path), 'source': path.read_text()} for path in scripts]
patterns = ['marlin-receipt-crash 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-chain 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-rebase 真实 *',
            'marlin-receipt-accepted 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-corrupt 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-refresh 真实 *',
            'marlin-receipt-refresh-rebase 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-refresh-accepted 真实 *',
            'marlin-receipt-revoked 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-atomic 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-settle-atomic 真实 *',
            'marlin-receipt-key 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-confirmed-crash 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-shape 真实 *',
            'marlin-receipt-authority 真实 *', 'marlin-receipt-expiry 真实 *']
left = [str(path) for pattern in patterns for path in Path('/tmp').glob(pattern)]
assert not left, left
dependencies = ['packages/core/src/application.ts', 'packages/core/src/auth/index.ts', 'packages/core/src/auth/reader.ts',
                'packages/core/src/storage/database.ts', 'packages/core/src/storage/credentials.ts',
                'packages/core/src/runtime/owner-client.ts', 'packages/core/src/runtime/owner-contracts.ts',
                'packages/core/src/runtime/owner-host.ts', 'packages/core/src/runtime/owner-worker.ts',
                'packages/core/test/fixtures/core-owner-publication-worker.ts']
versions = {}
for package in ['better-sqlite3', 'tsx', 'typescript']:
    versions[package] = json.loads((root/'packages/core/node_modules'/package/'package.json').read_text())['version']
record = {
    'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'P1 durable encrypted IPC receipt recovery; IPC adapter only, public/private interfaces unchanged',
    'owned_files': [{'path': name, 'sha256': expected} for name, expected in owned.items()],
    'dependency_snapshot_at_freeze': [{'path': name, 'sha256': sha(root/name)} for name in dependencies],
    'dependency_snapshot_note': 'Root owns runtime and executes the final source-bound unified build/consumer checks; this snapshot is not a Windows or compiled-Node acceptance claim.',
    'commands': commands,
    'summary': {'focused': '20/20 PASS', 'related': '19/19 PASS', 'typecheck': 'npm run typecheck exit 0', 'build': 'not run', 'full_suite': 'not run'},
    'red_classification': {'crash_red': 'Actual owner Worker, real SQLite/Vault, response delivery barrier then forced termination; restart restored wrong unexposed new device.',
                           'fixture_failures': 'Initial Worker test logging marker had invalid event format/lowercase level; preserved original runs, not counted as product RED.',
                           'real_expanded_red': 'Missing durable journal, wrong persisted rebase, missing predecessor cleanup, corrupt ciphertext silently accepted, refresh credentials not restored, no session/journal atomic fault behavior.',
                           'first_implementation_failures': 'Two refresh failures from nonexistent device_sessions.deleted_at SQL; corrected against actual schema and retained evidence.'},
    'behavior': ['Encrypted versioned receipts and ipc.session atomically stored on the existing single writer.',
                 'Acceptance, discard, predecessor/refresh undo rebasing and both metadata records commit together.',
                 'Startup fully decrypts/validates both records before atomically rejecting unconfirmed receipts.',
                 'Same-device refresh undo uses exact digest and original-field capture; later accepted generation/external revocation/authority/expiry wins.',
                 'No private credentials exposed in renderer replies or test evidence; Worker parent sees only safe public DTOs.'],
    'limits': ['Earlier AuthService.issue-to-adapter-journal window remains outside frozen Auth/Application scope; possible orphaned unexposed issuance is not resolved here.',
               'Coordinator confirmation enqueue and Promise resolve are one message-turn linearization, not a cross-thread disk transaction. A crash before owner confirmation commit rejects that receipt.',
               'No live database, GUI, configured model, vendor request, Windows, build, full suite, schema/dependency change or commit.'],
    'runtime': {'node': subprocess.run(['node','--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip(), 'installed_dependencies': versions},
    'checks': {'tracked_diff_check_exit': tracked.returncode, 'all_owned_whitespace': checks, 'local_document_links': links,
               'temporary_fixture_patterns': patterns, 'remaining_fixtures': left},
    'temporary_scripts': cleanup,
}
for path in scripts:
    path.unlink()
for item in cleanup:
    item['removed'] = not Path(item['path']).exists()
assert all(item['removed'] for item in cleanup)
destination.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'manifest': str(destination.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(destination), 'owned_files': len(owned),
                  'command_logs': len(commands), 'links_checked': len(links), 'scripts_removed': len(cleanup)}, ensure_ascii=False))
